Definition: Gedor, a place in Palestine; also the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Gedor is a place in Palestine; also the name of three Israelites, named 7 times in Scripture, in Joshua and 1 Chronicles. The full story of the place lives in the Bible itself, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Gedor matters because God met His people in real places, not in abstractions. I hold that Gedor is worth knowing by name, even when the Bible says little about it.
